name: Kyouka Jikken 2 ~Tsun to Shita Maid Musume ga Innyuuka Suru ni Itaru Aramashi~
original_name: 狂化実験２～ツンとしたメイド娘が淫乳化するに至るあらまし～
source:
One man has agreed to give his body to experimental modification for the sake of the struggling nation in a time of continued war. He will become a woman, and in turn enter a special prostitution program. But never in his wildest imagination could he have guessed what came next... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE063821.html]DLsite English[/url]]
